ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity black pixels (approx. 90% of surface) to high-intensity white punctate pixels (approx. 10% of surface).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary substrate is uniform dark-low intensity. High-contrast white circular blobs are distributed as discrete coordinates across the field, with dense geometric clusters at the extreme left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and a depth reaching roughly one-fifth of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged boundary with frequent high-amplitude peaks and valleys (3-10 pixel variations) across the entire trailing edge, heavily modified by calcified protrusions at the tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep transitioning into irregular, jagged protrusions at the distal margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of circular high-contrast pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed unevenly across both lobes; primary concentration located at the distal lobe tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel white linear segments (scratches) visible on the left lobe, crossing the dark pigmentation field diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large-scale calcified biological growths (barnacle colonies) creating significant topographical displacement on the outer margins of both fluke lobes.
